name: io.github.tripleaceme/dqsleuth
title: dqsleuth
description: Read-only data quality investigation: metric-drop attribution, duplicates, joins, freshness, dbt tests.

environmentVariables.name: DQSLEUTH_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Project directory to scan for data files and dbt artifacts. Defaults to the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: DQSLEUTH_POSTGRES_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Postgres URL, attached read-only. Use a read-only role.
